title: Training Questions: The Policy-Change Rate on Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Certificates
content:
**Q. What decides the policy-change rate on a policy-number amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate?**
The number of amendments the filing's record shows within the past 12 months.

| Amendments on the filing's record within the past 12 months | Policy-change rate |
|---|---|
| None | 7.50 |
| Exactly one | 15.00 |
| Two or more | 22.50 |

**Q. Which amendments count?**
Every amendment entry on the filing's record — vehicle change, address change, policy number change or name change.

**Q. What is "within the past 12 months"?**
A window of a number of months covers the entries dated less than that many whole months before today, whole months being counted from the entry's date to today. An amendment entered 11 whole months ago counts; one entered 12 whole months ago does not.

**Q. Hypothetical: one address amendment 13 months ago and nothing since.**
None within the window: 7.50.

**Q. Hypothetical: a vehicle change 2 months ago and a name change 6 months ago.**
Two within the window: 22.50.
